notes.title: Update spoiler for Timension's next update!
notes.content:
It has been more than a month since we posted the last update. Last month, we did not stop improving Timension project. After team discussion and detailed analysis, we think we should add some exciting elements this time, the element of dimension, into this game. Please allow me to make some spoilers by showing you guys a frame from my favorite movie, Tron: Legacy.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30974045/50daa72ae778411891494c72ce4264714af4c919.jpg

Also, the Steam community is temporarily closed (for Chinese users) due to Steam’s policies change or China’s Great Firewall. However, the community is still accessible to us through proxies. Though, we cannot always get the latest news from the community at all time due to the slow proxied Internet connection. But this does not mean we are no longer concerned about your discussion. Every suggestion or comment of our game is taken deliberate consideration. On behalf of Team Full Sail, we hope you a Merry Christmas!

notes.title: 9/11/2017 Reparative update
notes.content:
Timension update bulletin V1.1:
1. Now the level scan animations can be skipped while playing.
2. The starting platform of the third level will no longer block the player's sight.
3. Hints to reset levels are added in.
4. Fixed a bug in the first level: backtracking before the explosion could result in program error.

We published a small range of program fixes based on player feedback in recent days. This update does not include any new levels and game content, and more content updates will be released in about 20 days after.

Sincerely,

Team Full Sail
9/11/2017

notes.title: Important notice
notes.content:
We're very sorry to inform that due to some technical errors that were not detected during the testing phase caused our game to not start properly in the previous hours. Fortunately, the problem has now been properly solved. More inconvenience please forgive us, thank you for your support!

Sincerely,

Yansong Liu
Timesion director, lead programmmer

* Players who are still unable to run the game properly please restart the Steam client for program updates *
